headlines.text: Back on this day in 2020, Penta El Zero M vs. Rey Fenix headlined Dynamite, rated 8.12 ? one of the better matches of the year.
Rewind to 2023, when The WorkHorsemen made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.39.
On this day in 2022, Brian Cage vs. Dante Martin locked horns for the first time, opening the card on Rampage, rated 6.63.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, Allin & Sting & Copeland made a statement, debuting in the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.22.
Turning the clock back to 2020: Red Velvet made their AEW debut against Tay Conti, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.21.
Looking back to 2020, when The Natural Nightmares vs. The Butcher and The Blade met for the very first time in a Bunkhouse Tag match on Dynamite, rated 7.71 ? a strong outing.
